title: What happens when I first arrive at Ashaeiynn, and how will volunteers and mentors help me settle in?

segments.text: Arrival & Shoe Etiquette ​Footwear Policy: No footwear is permitted inside the premises. As soon as you enter through the main gate of Ashaeiynn, you will find a shoe rack located on your right-hand side. Please remove your shoes and place them safely in the rack before proceeding. ​Reception & Check-In Process ​Warm Welcome: After placing your shoes in the rack, walk through the large main glass entrance door. On your left, you will find the reception desk, where the Ashaeiynn team will welcome you. ​ID Verification & Passes: Official staff and volunteers will guide you through the check-in process: ​Registered Members: Will be issued an official Member Pass/ID. ​Accompanying Guests & Non-Members: Will be issued a Visitor Pass/ID. ​Note: Please have your official government-issued ID ready for verification. ​Identifying Volunteers & Mentors ​Easy Spotting: You will be living alongside dedicated volunteers and mentors throughout your stay, so guidance is always nearby. ​Volunteers: Can be easily identified by the specific color of their ID lanyards/wristbands, which differ from guest badges. ​Mentors: Can be identified by their special badges or sashes. ​Orientation & Settling In Step-by-Step You don't need to worry about navigating the venue on your own—our volunteers will walk you through everything step by step: ​Luggage Storage: Volunteers will assist you in taking your bags and belongings to the designated luggage room. ​Freshening Up: They will guide you to the restrooms so you can unpack basic needs and freshen up after your journey. ​Venue Tour: They will give you an introductory tour of the ashaeiynn grounds and key areas. Initial Spiritual Arrival Process: Volunteers will walk you through the essential initial spiritual rituals required upon arriving on the grounds: ​Veneration of Rameshwar Sarkar: Offering jal (water) and performing puja dedicated to Rameshwar Sarkar. ​Main Hall Darshan: Entering the main hall to bow down and offer your prayers before the two Akhand Deepaks and Gurudev’s idol. ​Havan Area & Parikrama: Proceeding to the havan area to perform the sacred Parikrama. ​Meeting Parikshit Bhaiya: Following these arrival rituals, volunteers will guide you directly to meet Parikshit Bhaiya based on availability.
